titleEn: Greeneye Technology Expands Dealer Network with Intellifarms Northern Division
titleZh: Greeneye Technology与Intellifarms北部部门合作扩大经销商网络
summaryZh: Greeneye Technology宣布与Intellifarms北部部门建立经销商合作伙伴关系，以扩大其AI精准喷洒技术在美国中西部北部的销售与服务网络。该技术可减少80-90%的非残留除草剂使用，且无需软件订阅费，可加装于现有喷雾器。此次合作旨在为种植者提供本地化支持，推动精准农业技术应用。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了AI精准喷洒技术在种植业的最新应用与市场拓展，其减少除草剂使用、降低成本的实践案例对智慧畜牧行业中的精准农业应用具有参考价值。
contentFull:
By Greeneye Technology 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 Greeneye Technology, a global leader in AI-powered targeted spraying technology, today announced a new dealer partnership with Intellifarms Northern Division, expanding Greeneye’s sales, service, and customer support network across the Upper Midwest.

 Based in Britton, South Dakota, Intellifarms Northern Division serves growers throughout South Dakota, North Dakota, Iowa, Kansas, and surrounding agricultural regions. The company has historically focused on grain operations products and services and has recently started to expand its offerings into precision agriculture technology. The partnership strengthens Greeneye’s ability to deliver local expertise, installation support, and long-term customer service as adoption of targeted spraying technology continues to grow.

 Greeneye’s technology aligns closely with Intellifarms’ philosophy of delivering practical, ROI-driven solutions to growers. The advanced targeted spraying system enables farmers to reduce non-residual herbicide use by an average of 80–90% while maintaining effective weed control. Its unique dual-tank, dual-line configuration allows operators to broadcast residual herbicides while simultaneously targeting non-residual herbicides only where weeds are detected. With no per-acre software fees, 24/7 day-and-night operation, and the ability to retrofit onto existing commercial sprayers, Greeneye provides growers with an economically compelling path to precision spraying without replacing equipment or adding ongoing usage costs.

 “Our solution delivers significant value for growers, and successful adoption depends on having knowledgeable local partners,” said Keith Crow, Greeneye Technology’s General Manager for North America. “Intellifarms has built its business around trusted customer relationships, technical expertise, and long-term support, making them an excellent partner to represent Greeneye Technology across the Upper Midwest.”

 “We’ve always believed our role is to help farmers successfully adopt technologies that create real value for their operations,” said Jared Holland, President of Intellifarms Northern Division. “Greeneye’s targeted spraying system stood out because it combines measurable input savings with practical features that fit the way growers already farm. We’re excited to help growers evaluate where it fits, support successful implementation, and provide the long-term service they’ve come to expect from our team.”

 Greeneye Technology was founded in 2017 in Tel Aviv, Israel, with the mission to develop alternative and sustainable solutions to current crop protection practices to meet the growing global demand for food production while also increasing productivity and profitability for farmers. The company is pioneering the use of precision spraying technology by harnessing AI and deep machine learning to enable intelligent, real-time decisions in the field that are proven to cut chemical use by 88% on average and improve weed control efficacy compared to standard broadcast spraying. translationZh:
Greeneye Technology是AI驱动靶向喷洒技术的全球领导者，今日宣布与Intellifarms北部部门建立新的经销商合作伙伴关系，将Greeneye的销售、服务和客户支持网络扩展至中西部北部地区。

Intellifarms北部部门总部位于南达科他州布里顿，为南达科他州、北达科他州、爱荷华州、堪萨斯州及周边农业地区的种植者提供服务。该公司历来专注于谷物运营产品和服务，最近开始将其产品扩展到精准农业技术领域。此次合作增强了Greeneye在当地提供专业知识、安装支持和长期客户服务的能力，以满足靶向喷洒技术日益增长的应用需求。

Greeneye的技术与Intellifarms为种植者提供实用、以投资回报为导向的解决方案的理念高度契合。先进的靶向喷洒系统使农民能够将非残留除草剂的使用量平均减少80-90%，同时保持有效的杂草控制。其独特的双罐、双管路配置允许操作员在播撒残留除草剂的同时，仅对检测到杂草的区域靶向喷洒非残留除草剂。无需每亩软件费用、全天候昼夜运行，并且可以加装到现有商用喷雾器上，Greeneye为种植者提供了一条经济可行的精准喷洒路径，无需更换设备或增加持续使用成本。

“我们的解决方案为种植者带来了显著价值，而成功采用依赖于熟悉当地情况的合作伙伴，”Greeneye Technology北美区总经理Keith Crow表示。“Intellifarms的业务建立在客户信任、技术专长和长期支持的基础上，是代表Greeneye Technology在中西部北部地区的理想合作伙伴。”

“我们一直认为自己的角色是帮助农民成功采用能为他们的运营创造真正价值的技术，”Intellifarms北部部门总裁Jared Holland表示。“Greeneye的靶向喷洒系统之所以脱颖而出，是因为它结合了可衡量的投入品节省和符合农民现有耕作方式的实用功能。我们很高兴能帮助种植者评估其适用场景，支持成功实施，并提供他们期望从我们团队获得的长期服务。”

该合作伙伴关系立即生效。
